purpose: Bind the v4 counter schema to the exact two-lane endpoint equation used by the 337de8bf scoped performance baseline.

scope.applicability: Only a receipt that binds this amendment and satisfies every proof obligation may use endpoint-corrected baseline qualification.

preserves: all cycle, slot, head, memory and request-detail conservation rules
all overflow, invalid-event, complete, available and unknown-ratio gates
normative_precedence.precedence_rule: This amendment overrides only the v4 equal-lane qualification proxy; every exact endpoint, conservation, identity and error check remains normative.

proof_obligations: the BOUNDARY start/end markers are unique and bind the policy start/stop PCs
FINAL is unique, complete, successful and exactly matches both boundary deltas
COUNTERS_FINAL is unique, complete, available, non-overflowing and has zero invalid events
COUNTERS_FINAL start_lane/end_lane/phase_aligned match the boundary markers
retired_slots equals retired instructions and unused_slots equals slot_capacity - retired_slots
primary cycle and slot ledgers conserve exactly
head, memory and memory-request nested aggregates conserve exactly
unknown or unclassified cycle ratio remains within the bound measurement contract
all required repetitions are bit-exact without outlier removal

rationale.root_cause: The counter marker already emits the exact endpoint correction; requiring equal lanes is a redundant proxy that rejects a mathematically conserved lane1-to-lane0 interval.
rationale.safety_property: No tolerance or missing bucket is introduced; the exact two-lane interval equation replaces only the proxy.
non_claims: no workload, ROI, simulator, configuration or latency change
no full causal CPI, occupancy or PPA qualification
